newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki seen busy, forestries get mixed reviews.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki seen busy, forestries get mixed reviews.

text.p: There was a mixed reception for forestry results with some brokers seeing a slight plus and others unimpressed by Thursday's slightly better than expected reports, and the overall tone for shares was indecisive.

"Basically there are no positive surprises for them (the forestries) or the other companies either, so I think that would dampen sentiment -- but there are people who think forestries should go higher so we'll have a good market," one broker said.
"We think things will be slightly on the plus side," another said after January-August results from forestry majors UPM-Kymmene and Metsa-Serla.
